relationships.subject: heat-sensitive C-fiber nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: Heat sensitive C-fiber nociceptors are peptidergic, largely express the heat-gated ion channel Transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (Trpv1)

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: specific deletion of Nav1.7 in C-LTMRs, which is essential for action potential generation, produces mechanical and cooling deficits(Middleton et al., 2022)

key_findings: Review: small fiber neuropathy typically has late onset and age is a key driver, with idiopathic cases near 50%.
Cellular themes in SFN animal models include lipid dysregulation, mitochondrial stress, axonal transport defects, protein aggregation and channelopathies.
